features.name: Fort Independence
features.description: Fort Independence occupies the center of Castle Island. The exterior loop is generally available during park hours, but interior tours are seasonal and event closures are common.
features.source_label: Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation

details.informationSourceLabel: Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation

features.name: Castle Island Loop
features.description: The short paved loop circles Fort Independence with harbor, ship, and airport views. Seawalls are exposed to wind and have immediate water edges.
features.source_label: Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation

details.informationSourceLabel: Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation
details.imageAlt: Castle Island Loop at Castle Island

features.name: Pleasure Bay beach and loop
features.description: Pleasure Bay lies west of the fort and supports a longer accessible loop plus seasonal swimming. Check lifeguards, water quality, beach mats, tide, and wind.
features.source_label: Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation

details.informationSourceLabel: Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation
details.imageAlt: Pleasure Bay beach and loop at Castle Island

features.name: Sullivan's and family picnic area
features.description: Sullivan's is the seasonal food counter near the fort parking lot, playground, picnic space, and restrooms. Lines and parking peak on warm weekends.
features.source_label: Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation

details.coordinateSource: AuditMap reviewed Castle Island map placement
details.informationSourceLabel: Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation
details.imageAlt: Sullivan's and family picnic area at Castle Island

features.name: Castle Island Playground
features.description: The playground is beside the fort-side family area near parking, food, and seasonal restrooms. It is exposed to harbor wind and sun, and the nearby seawall requires close supervision.
features.source_label: Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation

details.coordinateSource: AuditMap reviewed Castle Island map placement
details.informationSourceLabel: Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation
details.imageAlt: Castle Island Playground at Castle Island

features.name: Fishing pier and harbor seawall
features.description: Fishing is popular along the harbor-facing pier and seawall near Fort Independence. Bring required gear and licenses, yield to walkers, watch hooks and slippery edges, and check wind and marine conditions.
features.source_label: Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation

details.coordinateSource: AuditMap reviewed Castle Island map placement
details.informationSourceLabel: Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation
details.imageAlt: Fishing pier and harbor seawall at Castle Island

features.name: Head Island Causeway
features.description: The causeway is the narrow connection between the Pleasure Bay loop and the fort-side island. It is paved and scenic but exposed to wind, waves, runners, bicycles, and immediate water edges.
features.source_label: Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation

details.coordinateSource: AuditMap reviewed Castle Island map placement
details.informationSourceLabel: Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation
details.imageAlt: Head Island Causeway at Castle Island

features.name: Carson Beach
features.description: Carson Beach is the western beach segment of the larger DCR reservation, well beyond the fort loop. It has its own access, parking, seasonal lifeguard and beach-service conditions, so navigate directly to the beach.
features.source_label: Massachusetts Department of Conservation and Recreation
